mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no, customer_id, status, total_amount, version, created_at FROM customer_order WHERE order_no=#{orderNo} AND customer_id=#{customerId}
SELECT p.sku, p.name AS product_name, i.quantity, i.unit_price FROM order_item i JOIN product p ON p.id=i.product_id WHERE i.order_id=#{orderId}
SELECT status, refund_status, paid_at, refund_requested_at FROM payment WHERE order_id=#{orderId}
SELECT description, location, occurred_at FROM shipment_event WHERE order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY occurred_at DESC
SELECT request_id, result_code, result_message FROM order_operation WHERE request_id=#{requestId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO order_operation(request_id, order_id, operation_type, result_code, result_message) VALUES(#{requestId}, #{orderId}, 'CANCEL', 'PROCESSING', '订单操作处理中')
mapper.update: UPDATE customer_order SET status='CANCELLED', version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND customer_id=#{customerId} AND version=#{version} AND status IN ('CREATED','PAID','PROCESSING')

UPDATE payment SET refund_status=CASE WHEN status='PAID' THEN 'PROCESSING' ELSE refund_status END, refund_requested_at=CASE WHEN status='PAID' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ELSE refund_requested_at END WHERE order_id=#{orderId}
UPDATE order_operation SET result_code=#{code}, result_message=#{message} WHERE request_id=#{requestId}
